definition: Solve (G + alpha*trace(G)/width I) W=R in float64 from H289 training statistics; select by pooled existing-validation response MSE. Same standardized coordinates; isotropic coefficient penalty is coordinate dependent. Save all24 candidates. Compare best expanded96/128 to best64, not only unregularized64.

gates.expanded_gain: best expanded vs best64 validation MSE reduction>=2%
gates.ridge_gain: best expanded vs same-width unregularized validation reduction>=2%

scope: Existing validation model selection, not fresh confirmation. Intact behavior requires separate evaluation. No response-informed feature selection here.
